Reviewed serial trajectory: single-agent probing of CLI behavior, no delegation, no implementation project delivered before timeout.

parallel.requirements: Recognized that the task required an original behavioral reimplementation of the jot/jt CLI using only interaction with the supplied executable and README.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent created a probe harness, launched an eight-dimension workflow with gap critics, and kept ownership of coding the Rust implementation locally.
parallel.implementation: It scaffolded a std-only Rust project and wrote toml_lite.rs, help_text.rs, cli.rs, and main.rs while continuing local probes of state files, help text, parsing, and filesystem behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The artifact contains the Rust project, release target, and executable, but the final response is empty and official artifact validation marks it not OK.
parallel.verification: The parent built an initial scaffold and used differential probing scripts, but there is no completed end-to-end official-aligned verification before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow findings were not returned as an aggregate, implementation remained incomplete, the process timed out, and official evaluation failed at compile time with no tests run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same reverse-engineering requirement and explored the documented jot CLI only by running the provided executable and reading bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflows disabled, one agent locally probed help text, state files, command behavior, filesystem operations, and panic paths without delegating work.
serial.implementation: The serial attempt performed extensive local observation but did not create a replacement source project or buildable implementation in the submitted artifact.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact contains original files and runtime state directories rather than a new coherent implementation tree, and artifact validation is not OK.
serial.verification: It verified many behavior details against the binary during probing, but it had no replacement implementation to validate end-to-end before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out after probing and repository inspection, delivered an empty final response, and official evaluation failed at compile time with all tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the cleanroom reverse-engineering requirement and obeyed the observation-only framing while planning an original Rust reimplementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had the same prompt and also treated the executable and README as the only behavioral source of truth.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both understood the task, but parallel moved into implementation while serial stayed in probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent split behavioral discovery across workflow children by command dimension and kept the coding path for itself.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The control run had workflows and delegation tools disabled and therefore used one local trajectory for probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child-result dependencies; serial had no child ownership boundary and no cross-agent coordination risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child briefs included the harness, observation restrictions, exact-output reporting format, and dimension-specific probe scopes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial context stayed in one agent transcript; findings from README and local probes did not cross a handoff boundary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The important context difference is not an incomplete brief but that returned child findings never became parent context.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel scaffolded and populated a Rust project with helper modules and CLI parsing while probes were still running.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial invested its time in detailed behavioral probes and did not write replacement source files or a build project.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delivered a partial implementation tree; serial delivered mostly state/probe artifacts and no implementation project.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Workflow children produced probe activity, but the parent-visible journal remained started-only and the parent check showed no completed workflow results.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve; all observations stayed in the single main trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel suffered a child-result lifecycle failure that serial could not have: findings existed below the parent but did not return as an aggregate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel's final artifact includes a Rust project, target output, and executable, with probe scratch state separate from final implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's artifact includes runtime state directories and original workspace metadata rather than a final implementation tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation state differs materially, but there is no evidence of parallel shared-state write collisions or artifact leakage causing contamination.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used local builds and differential probes but did not close with official-aligned integrated acceptance; official evaluation compile_failed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran many reference-binary probes but had no produced replacement to verify; official evaluation also compile_failed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked final acceptance evidence; parallel had partial implementation checks, while serial had only behavioral observation checks.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full time budget with one workflow, 29 subagent logs, heavy child-token use, and a timeout before workflow aggregation or finalization.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed the full time budget, but with zero subagents and only local tool calls before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but parallel spent substantial budget on unreturned child work while serial spent its budget on single-agent probing.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official evaluations completed and both solutions failed before test execution with compile_failed and 846 tests not_run. The process difference is that parallel produced a partial Rust implementation while its child probe workflow never returned an aggregate, whereas serial performed local probing only and submitted no buildable implementation project; this is a strategy/process contrast, not an official outcome split.
parallel_contributors: Partial Rust implementation existed but was incomplete and not accepted by the official compile step.
Workflow probe findings remained below the parent and were not available as an aggregate before timeout.
serial_contributors: Single-agent probing produced observations but no replacement source tree or buildable implementation before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel attempted a Rust reimplementation; serial mostly accumulated behavioral evidence and runtime state artifacts.
Both timed out and both artifacts were marked not OK, so compile failure is shared rather than discordant.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process consequence only

Reject: no separately completed component implementations required a missing integrator; the parent was the integration point.
Reject: the parent created the project tree and executable artifact, so assembly was owned even though incomplete and failed.
Reject: the parent controlled the end-to-end flow; the failure was result return and timeout, not an ownerless pipeline.
Reject: implementation was not blocked behind one mandatory serial preflight; the parent implemented while workflow probes ran.
Reject: the parallel run did not complete investigation as a separate phase before implementation; probing and coding overlapped.
Reject: while the implementation path was deadline constrained, the more direct evidenced issue is unreturned probe findings.
Reject: fan-out and timeout are screening signals, but the retained direct boundary is concrete child findings not returning to the parent.
Reject: no single child assignment is shown as the dominant overbroad cause; the workflow used many scoped probe dimensions.
Reject: child briefs included the task, harness, observation-only rule, output format, and detailed dimension requirements.
Reject: the children produced behavioral reports for the parent, not interoperating code components with missing file or API contracts.
Reject: no completed handoff is shown losing known information in transfer; the aggregate result did not return.
Reject: the parent did not receive a bulky completed report and then fail to reduce it; there was no returned aggregate.
Reject: no parent action consumed a superseded child report or stale workspace description.
Reject: no conflicting returned reports reached the parent and remained unadjudicated.
Reject: the parent made no observable whole-task completion claim supported only by partial checks; it timed out with an empty final response.
Reject: the run shows repeated workflow starts and interrupted children, but no replacement retry that lacked inherited checkpoints and repeated prior work as a distinct episode.

candidates.reason: Reject: child interruption appears as run timeout/interruption, not a parent or workflow stop/cancel decision before finalized work.
Reject: no complete directly promotable candidate or compatible completed component set was available and merely left unpromoted.
Reject: no child result or implementation change was merged only after integrated verification.
Reject: the delegated children were behavioral probe and critic agents, not completed implementation owners with code to join.

The workflow delegated probe and critic agents to produce implementation-driving behavioral findings, and child logs show concrete findings. The parent later inspected workflow state and saw only started records, so no aggregate findings were returned or consumed before timeout.
candidates.realized_consequence: Concrete behavioral probe findings remained trapped in child trajectories while the parent kept implementing from local probes and reached timeout with no workflow aggregate to inspect.
candidates.near_match_reason: Fan-out and timeout are visible, but this retained episode uses the more direct result-lifecycle boundary: concrete probe findings failed to return to the parent.

candidates.reason: Reject: interruptions existed, but the direct retained boundary is the non-return of concrete probe findings; no separate post-failure takeover episode is evidenced.
Reject: no concrete completed child result was visible to the parent and then ignored at a decision point.
Reject: the parent actively probed, implemented, built, and checked workflow status rather than waiting blindly without inspection.
Reject: child writes were probe sandbox artifacts, not competing implementation files claiming overlapping final behavior.
Reject: there is no evidence of live agents editing the same final source or configuration file and reconciling a collision.
Reject: no child-produced non-entry source file was replaced or deleted by another actor.
Reject: no concurrent actor replaced the required executable or submitted entry point while another owned or used it.
Reject: no broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion invalidated another actor's final-tree work or provenance.
Reject: although children wrote probe scratch state, there is no concrete unstable final-workspace provenance problem from shared implementation writes.
Reject: no generated scratch artifact from a concurrent actor was consumed as a stable reference input contaminating implementation or verification.

cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 32 Level-3 candidates were reviewed; only the child probe result-return boundary cleared the paired retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: The timeout, broad workflow, child interruptions, and missing aggregate were not split into multiple labels because they share one lifecycle consequence and corrective boundary.
